description: She wears an opaque deep blue fitted long gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and a full floor-length skirt. Narrow gold geometric woven trim decorates the neckline, vertical bodice edges, cuffs and hem. Round gold brooches fasten the shoulder straps and an ornate belt with hanging decorative medallions marks the waist. A pale ivory textured wrap edged in blue and gold rests around the forearms and hangs at the sides. An ivory underdress shows through the skirt opening, with dark closed shoes beneath. Fabric appears woven and substantial; exact fiber is uncertain.
